<?php
class QuietFloatRead {
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return $incoming !== "skip"; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): float { echo "G;"; return "0.0"; }
}
function quietFloatRhs(): int { echo "RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietFloatRead;
$selector = "zero";
echo empty($receiver->$selector) ? "EMPTY;" : "BAD;";
echo ($receiver->$selector ?? quietFloatRhs()) === 0.0 ? "ZERO;" : "BAD;";
echo ($receiver->skip ?? quietFloatRhs()) === 9 ? "FALL;" : "BAD;";
echo $selector === "zero" ? "NAME;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
class QuietFloatAssign {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): float { echo "G;"; return 0; }
    public function __set(string $incoming, $value): void { echo "BAD_SET;"; }
}
function quietFloatAssignRhs(): int { echo "BAD_RHS;"; return 9; }
$receiver = new QuietFloatAssign;
echo ($receiver->value ??= quietFloatAssignRhs()) === 0.0 ? "ZERO_KEEP;" : "BAD;";
echo "DONE;";
